jcr:content.jcr:title: Progressive Overload Explained
jcr:content.jcr:description: How to increase training volume and intensity safely for long-term strength gains.

articleBody.text:
Train Hard, Progress Smart

Progressive overload means adding small challenges over time: more reps, better control, or heavier loads.

Track your lifts and recovery weekly to keep progressing without overtraining.
